title: centaurium minus var. suffruticosum
intro: Centaurium minus var. suffruticosum, commonly known as Chironion, is a perennial plant species belonging to the Gentianaceae family. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which are attributed to its ability to stimulate digestion, relieve gastrointestinal issues, and exhibit anti-inflammatory effects. The health benefits of Centaurium minus var. suffruticosum include its potential to reduce symptoms of irritable bowel syndrome (IBS) and alleviate digestive discomfort. The therapeutic actions of this plant are largely due to its bioactive constituents, including iridoids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties.
